english.title: Manufacturer of electrical equipment fail to draw up declaration of conformity / affix UK marking
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a manufacturer of electrical equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUIPMENT..), failed to

(A)_[draw up a declaration of conformity in accordance with regulation 38 (declaration of conformity)]_
(B)_[affix the UK marking in accordance with regulation 39]_

of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 before placing that equipment on the market
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 6(1), 50(1) and 51(1) of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016.
